slogan_content_1: Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll sleep better and soundly.
slogan_content_10: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
slogan_content_11: In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
slogan_content_12: It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
slogan_content_13: Smile in the mirror. Do that every morning and you'll start to see a big difference in your life.
slogan_content_14: Whatever life throws at me I'll take it and be grateful for it as well.
slogan_content_15: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart.
slogan_content_16: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
slogan_content_17: Once you replace negative thoughts with positive ones, you'll start having positive results.
slogan_content_18: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
slogan_content_19: The most important thing is to try and inspire people so that they can be great in whatever they want to do.
slogan_content_2: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
slogan_content_20: Our greatest weakness lies in giving up. The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
slogan_content_21: Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground.
slogan_content_22: You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
slogan_content_23: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
slogan_content_24: I can't give you a surefire formula for success, but I can give you a formula for failure: try to please everybody all the time.
slogan_content_25: We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give.
slogan_content_26: Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the little voice at the end of the day that says 'I'll try again tomorrow'.
slogan_content_27: Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a mystery. Today is a gift; that's why we call it The Present.
slogan_content_28: Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
slogan_content_29: Do what you feel in your heart to be right – for you’ll be criticized anyway.
slogan_content_3: It always seems impossible until it's done.
slogan_content_30: Happiness resides not in possessions, and not in gold, happiness dwells in the soul.
slogan_content_31: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
slogan_content_32: Problems are not stop signs, they are guidelines.
slogan_content_33: Many of life’s failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up.
slogan_content_34: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
slogan_content_35: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.
slogan_content_36: People will forget what you said and forget what you did, but people will never forget how you made them feel.
slogan_content_37: Attitude is a little thing that makes a BIG difference.
slogan_content_38: Whether you think you can or you think you can’t, you’re right!
slogan_content_39: If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
slogan_content_4: The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life.
slogan_content_40: To improve is to change; to be perfect is to change often.
slogan_content_41: Setting goals is the first step in turning the invisible into the visible.
slogan_content_42: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.
slogan_content_43: Clouds come floating into my life, no longer to carry rain or usher storm, but to add color to my sunset sky.
slogan_content_44: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
slogan_content_45: Focus on being productive instead of busy.
slogan_content_46: Do one thing every day that scares you.
slogan_content_47: Do not take life too seriously. You will never get out of it alive.
slogan_content_48: The meaning of things lies not in the things themselves, but in our attitude towards them.
slogan_content_49: Don't go through life, grow through life.
slogan_content_5: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
slogan_content_50: Life leaps like a geyser for those who drill through the rock of inertia.
slogan_content_51: Happiness grows at our own firesides, and is not to be picked in strangers' gardens.
slogan_content_52: Everything has its wonders, even darkness and silence, and I learn, whatever state I may be in, therein to be content.
slogan_content_53: Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn't people feel as free to delight in whatever sunlight remains to them?
slogan_content_54: Opportunity does not knock, it presents itself when you beat down the door.
slogan_content_55: With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
slogan_content_56: What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
slogan_content_57: We swallow greedily any lie that flatters us, but we sip only little by little at a truth we find bitter.
slogan_content_58: Three things cannot be long hidden: the sun, the moon, and the truth.
slogan_content_59: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present.
slogan_content_6: The only person you should try to be better than, is the person you were yesterday.
slogan_content_60: What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
slogan_content_61: Keep your face always toward the sunshine - and shadows will fall behind you.
slogan_content_62: When you are enthusiastic about what you do, you feel this positive energy. It's very simple.
slogan_content_63: A lot of times people look at the negative side of what they feel they can't do. I always look on the positive side of what I can do.
slogan_content_64: Our lives are a sum total of the choices we have made.
slogan_content_65: A good laugh is sunshine in the house.
slogan_content_66: Love one another and help others to rise to the higher levels, simply by pouring out love. Love is infectious and the greatest healing energy.
slogan_content_67: Healing yourself is connected with healing others.
slogan_content_7: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
slogan_content_8: The most satisfying thing in life is to have been able to give a large part of one's self to others.
slogan_content_9: Life is 10 percent what you make it, and 90 percent how you take it.
